[won](https://www.politico.eu/article/hungary-election-2018-viktor-orban-
fidesz-jobbik/) the general election by a landslide, securing his third
consecutive term in office. The far-right authoritarian is up for reelection
once again, and despite receiving
[support](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/07/world/europe/vance-hungary-orban-
fidesz-election.html) from Donald Trump and JD Vance, who traveled to Budapest
this week, Orban's chances [aren't looking as
promising](https://apnews.com/article/hungary-election-youth-voters-
orban-58e71836ef9e3a38bc478bdbde9ca0b0) this time around._

strategic win"** for Iran, and a major loss for Trump and Netanyahu; liberals

Donald Trump on Tuesday threatened to destroy Iran's **" whole civilization"**
unless its leaders agreed to a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

By Tuesday evening - instead of trying to kill the 90 million people living in
Iran, or bombing Iran's power plants and bridges as he had promised - Trump
announced **" a double sided CEASEFIRE!"** for two weeks. In doing so, Trump
all but admitted the reality that his illegal war is going terribly - and Iran
is _winning_.

**" We received a 10-point proposal from Iran, and believe it is a workable
basis on which to negotiate,"** the president
[announced](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-trump-begs-off-pledge-to) on Truth
Social - apparently referring to the 10-point plan that Iran had presented to
the US _before_ he threatened to murder its entire population.

Using this 10-point plan as a framework for a deal, rather than the previous
American 15-point plan, is _obviously_ a major win for Iran - which is,
indeed, declaring victory. Experts and commentators see it that way, too.

**" If Iran did in fact secure guarantees based on the '10 principles' Trump
referenced, that is not a marginal outcome, it is a strategic win for Tehran,
reinforcing its narrative and positioning,"**
[wrote](https://x.com/citrinowicz/status/2041658876903485928?s=46) Danny
Citrinowicz, a former top Israeli intelligence officer who focused on Iran. As
former US State Department official and veteran Middle East negotiator Aaron
David Miller [put
it](https://x.com/aarondmiller2/status/2041648201275511194?s=46), **" Iran has
won another round." **

Political scientist Robert A. Pape
[writes](https://x.com/ProfessorPape/status/2041715028663865471): **" Huge
strategic defeat for the US, biggest loss since Vietnam."**

The 10-point plan would allow Iran to continue its control over the Strait of
Hormuz, the crucial waterway that Iran has closed since the start of the war,
stopping the flow of oil and throttling the global economy.

Just a day earlier, Trump was
[fantasizing](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5818431-trump-us-
tolls-strait-of-hormuz/) about the US **" charging tolls"** for ships to
transit the strait. Now, it looks much more likely that Iran will keep doing
this instead, and that it will get to charge **" a $2M fee per ship."** In
another win for Iran, the plan would involve lifting **" all US sanctions on
Iran."**

Under Iran's [proposed
framework](https://x.com/IRANinKabul/status/2041703472303894615), the US would
allow Iran to continue its uranium enrichment program - which would mean
folding on the entire supposed basis for Trump's illegal war. This point was
included in the Farsi version of the plan, but
[reportedly](https://x.com/ap/status/2041697464583909693?s=46) omitted from
English versions shared by Iranian diplomats.

Some liberals will invariably revel in **"[TACO
Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trump_Always_Chickens_Out)"** memes about
how Trump always chickens out. But, as we reported at **Zeteo** on Tuesday,
[none of this is over](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-trump-begs-off-pledge-to).
The ceasefire, as of now, is only temporary. As Trump advisers and others in
the upper tiers of Trumplandia warned us, there's still a decent chance that
he escalates the war again soon.
